places.name: Maso dello Speck
places.near: Upper Strada Rezia, pedestrian zone
places.famousFor: Old-recipe speck & sausage maker's shop with the full South Tyrol pantry: mountain cheeses, honey, jams, grappa — a taste-of-the-valley souvenir stop
places.goodToKnow: Speck is pork — NOT halal; go for the cheeses (Graukäse, alpine cheese), honey, apple products and jams. Vacuum-packed cheese travels well. · Kids: All ages; cheese tasting

places.name: Avesani Gastronomia
places.near: Piazza Sant'Antonio / Str. Rezia 106
places.famousFor: Ortisei's best deli for cheeses, honey, jams, olive oil and gourmet groceries on Antonius square, praised for its cheese counter
places.goodToKnow: Speck, venison and wine also sold — for the family choose cheeses, breads, honey and dried fruit. Cash and cards. · Kids: All ages; quick stop

places.name: SPORTLER Selva
places.near: Strada Meisules 276, Selva centre near the Ciampinoi station
places.famousFor: The big South Tyrol outdoor chain's Selva store: hiking boots, kids' jackets, gloves and hats — the place to gear up for a cold October day at altitude
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat 8:30–12:00 & 15:00–19:00, Sun 9:00–12:00 & 16:00–19:00 (tel +39 0471 773388). End-of-summer sales in October; the Sportler Outlet is in Bolzano/Bressanone, not in the valley. · Location needs verification · Kids: All ages; kids' outdoor gear
places.address: Str. Meisules 276, 39048 Selva di Val Gardena BZ

places.name: Seceda Knife-Edge Ridge Viewpoint
places.near: Seceda cable car top station (2,500 m), then the marked 10-min path to the summit cross and ridge edge
places.notes: val-gardena.net Seceda 2026 regulations + seceda.it summer prices
places.famousFor: The Dolomites' most photographed shot: the tilted grass ridge falling away to the Fermeda/Odle towers, 10 min from the Seceda top station; sunrise/sunset gold on the spires
places.goodToKnow: 2026: Seceda lifts run 22 May–2 Nov 8:30–17:30 with MANDATORY online 30-min time slots (seceda.it, non-refundable); adult return €74, under 8 free; Dolomiti SuperSummer not accepted. Last lift down 17:30 = no sunset from the lift; for sunrise sleep at Rifugio Fermeda. Wind and October snow possible. · Location needs verification · Kids: Best 9+; exposed drop, hold the 4yo

places.name: Alpe di Siusi under Sassolungo – Sunrise/Sunset Meadows
places.near: Drive up to Compatsch BEFORE 9:00 (car ban 9–17) or stay overnight on the Alpe; otherwise first cable car 8:00
places.notes: moonhoneytravel Alpe di Siusi hike + seiseralm-dolomites car-ban rules
places.famousFor: The classic Seiser Alm postcard: rolling meadows, wooden huts and larches with Sassolungo and Sassopiatto behind, from the Compatsch–Saltria trail near Hotel Icaro / Malga Sanon
places.goodToKnow: For sunrise you must be on the Alpe before 9:00 by car (P2 Compatsch booking €30/day) or sleep up there; sunset is possible by car after 17:00 (downhill allowed anytime). Mid-October = golden larches + first snow on peaks. · Location needs verification · Kids: All ages; flat, needs early start

places.name: St. Johann in Ranui Chapel
places.near: Val di Funes road towards Zannes, ~1 h from Ortisei; pay parking €4/day near the chapel (card machine) plus a small free lot 2 min away
places.notes: northabroad.com San Giovanni + serenaslenses.net photo-spot guide
places.famousFor: Tiny 1744 baroque onion-dome chapel alone in a meadow under the Odle peaks — the Val di Funes icon
places.goodToKnow: The meadow is fenced; shoot from the public viewing platform on the road, or pay the €4 turnstile for the roped path closer to the chapel. Morning light on the peaks; no drones. · Kids: All ages; roadside platform

places.name: Santa Maddalena Church Panorama Viewpoint
places.near: Park in the village pay lots (Ranui/Putzen/Filler) and walk 15–30 min up the closed road to the viewpoint
places.famousFor: The hillside 'Panorama' viewpoint above Santa Maddalena village: church spire, farmhouses and the whole Odle/Geisler wall — the other Funes postcard
places.goodToKnow: Mid-May–Nov 2026: barriers stop non-resident cars driving to the viewpoint (residents/hotel guests only); day visitors park in the village (~€4/day). Bus 330 links Bressanone–Funes–Zannes hourly. Best late afternoon. · Kids: All ages; 20-min uphill walk

places.name: Passo Gardena Hairpins Viewpoint
places.near: Drive to the pass summit car park; walk a few minutes south/east of the car park for the sweeping switchback view
places.notes: inafarawayland.com Dolomites passes + val-gardena.com Gardena Pass
places.famousFor: The switchback ribbon dropping from the 2,121 m pass towards Colfosco with the Sella massif and Cir peaks behind — plus the Sassolungo view back west
places.goodToKnow: Larch forest below turns gold mid/late October; pass open unless snow. Late-afternoon light on the Sella; cold and windy at 2,100 m. Pass restaurant for hot drinks. · Location needs verification · Kids: All ages; roadside, hold hands
places.address: Passo Gardena summit, 39048 Selva di Val Gardena BZ

places.name: Lago di Carezza Mirror Platform
places.near: P1 car park (~€3/h) then the pedestrian tunnel to the platform, 1–2 min
places.famousFor: The boardwalk platform where the Latemar spires reflect in the emerald water — the 'rainbow lake' mirror shot
places.goodToKnow: Platform/tunnel open 9:00–18:00 in season; arrive at opening for still water and no crowds (no booking needed in 2026). Water level lowest in autumn but reflection still works on calm mornings. · Kids: All ages; boardwalk, fenced
places.address: Karersee / Lago di Carezza, SS241, 39056 Nova Levante BZ

places.name: Ortisei Parish Church & Village from the Hillside
places.near: Church square in the pedestrian zone; hillside view from the Troi Paian path towards St. Jacob's (20–30 min up)
places.notes: valgardena-groeden.com Parish Church of Ortisei + suedtirol.info
places.famousFor: The 1796 neoclassical parish church of St. Ulrich with its onion dome above painted Tyrolean houses, shot from the church square at blue hour or from the Sacun/Troi Paian hillside with Sassolungo behind
places.goodToKnow: Church open daytime (free); wooden altars carved by local masters. Best light: evening on the facade, morning from the hill. · Location needs verification · Kids: All ages; village stroll
places.address: Piazza S. Durich / Str. Rezia, 39046 Ortisei BZ

places.name: Centro Culturale Islamico 'Il Dialogo' Bolzano
places.near: ~40 km / 45–50 min drive from Ortisei via SS242 and A22/SS12 into Bolzano's industrial zone (Zona Industriale)
places.notes: savera.it + Radio NBC (Via Negrelli 5), moscheaildialogo.it + Mawaqit (phone, Jumu'ah)
places.famousFor: Val Gardena itself has NO mosque or prayer room; the nearest is Bolzano's main Islamic centre (est. 2003), which runs daily prayers and Jumu'ah (listed 12:35–13:15 on Mawaqit)
places.goodToKnow: Phone +39 351 588 4008; live prayer times at mawaqit.net/it/il-dialogo-bolzano-39100-italy; other small musallas reported at Via del Macello 18 and Via A. Volta 1 (Al Salam) but verify by phone; in the valley, pray in your apartment/hotel room

places.name: Despar Dolomiti Ortisei

places.notes: valgardena.it Despar Dolomiti page (address, hours, coords)
places.famousFor: The central supermarket in Ortisei's pedestrian zone: fresh produce, South Tyrolean products, organic range, bakery
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat 08:15–19:15 year-round; Sunday opening only in high winter/summer seasons, so expect it CLOSED on Sun 11 Oct; phone +39 0471 786189

places.name: Conad City Ortisei

places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat 08:00–19:00 (Sat afternoon 15:00–19:00 per valgardena.it); low season Sunday closed; phone +39 0471 786225

places.name: Valgardena Center (Despar) Selva
places.near: Streda Puez 1A, Selva centre; parking right at the entrance

places.goodToKnow: 23 May–31 Oct: open DAILY 08:00–19:00 including Sunday, the best Sunday option in the valley; phone +39 0471 773331
places.address: Streda Puez 1A, 39048 Selva di Val Gardena BZ

places.famousFor: Largest supermarket on the Alpe di Siusi side, at the entrance to Castelrotto with metered parking in front (van-friendly)
places.address: Via Oswald von Wolkenstein 8-10, 39040 Castelrotto BZ

places.name: Macelleria Halal (Via Resia) Bolzano
places.near: Via Resia 142, west Bolzano, ~5 min from the Ospedale di Bolzano and the A22 Bolzano Sud exit
places.notes: oraridiapertura24 listing (address/phone) + PagineGialle 'Halal spese tikka shop' (same phone)
places.famousFor: Halal butcher and ethnic grocery in Bolzano's Don Bosco district; the valley has no halal shops, so stock up here on a Bolzano day
places.goodToKnow: Phone +39 327 383 2332 (also listed as 'Halal Spese Tikka Shop'); directory hours unreliable, call ahead; 'Rizwan Spezie Carne Halal' is another halal grocer in Bolzano (no verified address)

places.name: Farmacia Sella Ortisei
places.near: Piazza Rezia 73/B, in the pedestrian centre next to the church
places.notes: valgardena.it Farmacia Sella page (address, hours, coords) + val-gardena.net pharmacy FAQ (rota)
places.famousFor: Ortisei's pharmacy on the main square (Piazza Rezia); medicines, homeopathy, baby/child products
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat 08:00–12:00 & 15:00–19:00; Sunday only when 'di turno' (duty rota rotates between the 3 valley pharmacies, posted on each door and on the South Tyrol farmacie-di-turno register); phone +39 0471 796125

places.name: Farmacia Dolomiti Dr. Berdou Selva
places.near: Streda Mëisules 246, Selva centre, near the Ciampinoi lift
places.notes: val-gardena.com pharmacy page (address, GPS, hours) + Tuttogardena 2026 p.93 (phone)
places.famousFor: Selva's pharmacy on the main street Streda Mëisules
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Fri 08:30–12:30 & 15:00–18:30, Sat 10:00–12:00, Sun closed unless on duty; phone +39 0471 795142; off-hours call-out only with an urgent prescription
places.address: Streda Mëisules 246, 39048 Selva di Val Gardena BZ

places.name: Tourist doctor (Guardia Medica Turistica) & GPs Val Gardena
places.near: Guardia Medica: Str. Nives 2, Selva. GP surgeries: Dr Kostner/Weber/Policastro at Streda Nives 45 Selva (+39 371 4459506) and Streda Trebinger 10 Ortisei (+39 391 4921043); Dr Trocker Streda Promeneda 1 Ortisei (+39 388 2580002)
places.notes: valgardena-groeden.com important numbers (seasons Jul–Sep/Dec–Apr) + Tuttogardena 2026 p.93 (GPs) + Selva municipality notice
places.famousFor: Seasonal walk-in tourist doctor at Nives square, Selva (1st floor of the climbing-wall building) – but it runs only July–Sept and mid-Dec–early Apr, so it is NOT operating 12–15 Oct; use the regular GPs below or 112
places.goodToKnow: Guardia Medica phone +39 0471 794266 (only in season); Ortisei GP hours Mon/Tue/Thu 08:30–11:00, Wed 14:00–18:00, Fri 08:00–11:30; EU/foreign visitors pay per visit; emergency and mountain rescue via 112 (Aiut Alpin +39 0471 797171)
places.address: Str. Nives 2, 39048 Selva di Val Gardena BZ

places.name: Ospedale di Bressanone (Pronto Soccorso)
places.near: Ortisei → Ponte Gardena → SS12/A22 north to Bressanone, hospital at Via Dante 51
places.famousFor: Nearest full hospital with 24h emergency room to Val Gardena (30–35 km, ~35 min); has paediatrics
places.goodToKnow: Switchboard +39 0472 812111; call 112 for an ambulance/helicopter rather than driving in a serious case

places.name: Ospedale Centrale di Bolzano (Pronto Soccorso)
places.near: West Bolzano, Via Lorenz Böhler 5; A22 exit Bolzano Sud then follow 'Ospedale'
places.notes: asdaa.it arrival page + paginebianche pronto soccorso listing
places.famousFor: South Tyrol's main hospital with 24h adult and paediatric emergency departments, ~40 km / 45 min from Ortisei
places.goodToKnow: Switchboard +39 0471 908111; ER +39 0471 908443; main entrances close 22:00–06:00 but the ER stays open 24/7

places.name: Parking + Garage Seceda (Ortisei)
places.near: Streda Annatal (Val d'Anna), signposted 'Seceda' from the SS242 roundabout at the east end of Ortisei
places.notes: valgardena.it Parking + Garage Seceda page (address, tariffs, coords)
places.famousFor: Covered garage plus open lot directly at the Seceda cable-car valley station, the natural drop for a Seceda day
places.goodToKnow: 05:00–19:00 €2.50/30 min, 19:00–05:00 €0.80/h, daily max €30; open 24/7; NO height limit published – a high-roof 9-seater should use the open-air part or call +39 0471 796531 first

places.name: Garage Central Ortisei
places.near: Via Stazione 1 (Streda Stazion), below the centre on the Bolzano side; 24h in/out
places.notes: parkurtijei.it Garage Central page (tariffs, spaces) + valgardena.it listing (coords)
places.famousFor: Municipal underground garage (~222 spaces, built 2000) at Via Stazione, 3 min walk to the main squares and the Resciesa funicular – best base for the pedestrian centre
places.goodToKnow: €2.50/h, €20/day max; 'Happy Hour Card' (€10 deposit) gives 90 min free; height limit NOT published – call +39 0471 797547 before entering with a high-roof van; open-air alternative is Parcheggio Setil by the Mont Sëuc lift

places.name: Garage Mont Sëuc (Alpe di Siusi cable car, Ortisei)
places.near: Streda Setil, west end of Ortisei, signposted 'Alpe di Siusi / Mont Sëuc'
places.notes: valgardena.it Garage Mont Sëuc page (address, coords, spaces) + thedolomitesguide.com (Setil lot)
places.famousFor: Paid garage at the valley station of the Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi (Mont Sëuc) cable car, 2 min from the centre over the pedestrian bridge; reportedly the cheapest covered parking in town
places.goodToKnow: Valgardena.it lists 81 spaces (other sources say 240 incl. the open Setil lot); ~€0.50/h summer per search sources; no height limit published – phone +39 0471 797897; open-air Parcheggio Setil next door is the safe choice for a 9-seater

places.name: Ortisei ZTL (limited-traffic zone) rules
places.near: Approach Ortisei on the SS242 and turn off to Garage Central / Mont Sëuc / Seceda before the centre; never follow the sat-nav into Strada Rezia
places.notes: Comune di Ortisei ZTL notice (via search summary) + Locauto/Dolomites Guide parking pages
places.famousFor: Strada Rezia between Col da Ianon and the Sant'Antonio church is a 24-hour camera-enforced ZTL (2 cameras); a wider 'ZTL Centro' applies daily 10:00–18:00 in high season (Dec–Apr, Jun–Sep)
places.goodToKnow: Hotel/apartment guests inside the zone must be registered by the host via the municipality's online portal BEFORE driving in (send your plate on booking); fines arrive by post to the rental company months later · Location needs verification
places.address: Strada Rezia (Col da Ianon – Chiesa S. Antonio), 39046 Ortisei BZ

places.name: Alpe di Siusi road ban & P2 Compatsch parking
places.near: Alternative without the car: Ortisei Mont Sëuc cable car straight onto the plateau, or Siusi–Alpe di Siusi gondola (free parking at its valley station) or bus 10 from Castelrotto
places.notes: seiseralm.it access page (ban hours, P1/P2 prices, reservation rule from 29 Jun 2026)
places.famousFor: The Siusi–Compatsch road is closed to private cars 09:00–17:00 every day; you may drive up only before 09:00 or after 17:00 AND with an online parking reservation (P1 Spitzbühl €15/day, P2 Compatsch €30/day, bookable from 6 days ahead); downhill any time
places.goodToKnow: Parking also banned 23:00–05:00; with 7 people the Ortisei cable car (adult return ~€31) vs. one €30 P2 ticket + 08:45 start is the trade-off; hotels on the plateau issue their own access permits

places.name: Buses 350 & 172 + Val Gardena Guest Pass
places.near: Main Ortisei stops: Piazza S. Antonio and the Setil/Mont Sëuc station; timetables valid 14 Dec 2025–12 Dec 2026
places.notes: valgardena.it bus-schedule page + fahrplan.it line 172 + suedtirolmobil.info tariffs from 1 Apr 2026
places.famousFor: Line 350 runs Bolzano–Ponte Gardena–Ortisei–S. Cristina–Selva all year (every 15–30 min in the valley); line 172 links Ortisei Piazza S. Antonio–Castelrotto–Siusi cable car (~36 min, roughly hourly 08:31–17:31)
places.goodToKnow: Stays booked through a tourist-association member get the free Val Gardena Guest Pass (formerly Mobil Card) = free buses in the valley, but NOT the Alpe di Siusi shuttles 10/11; otherwise südtirolmobil single ticket €0.20/km (min €2) or Mobilcard 3 days €30–32 adult / €15–16 child 6–13; Südtirolmobil info +39 0471 220880

places.name: Fuel stations Ortisei (Eni Tresval & Q8 Pontives) + winter-tyre rule
places.near: Eni: Streda Tresval 80, Ortisei (46.5802, 11.6395 is the Q8 at Pontives on the SS242)
places.notes: valgardena.it Eni and Q8 POI pages (addresses, hours, Q8 coords) + alto-adige.com winter-equipment rule
places.famousFor: The two fuel stops closest to Ortisei: Eni at Streda Tresval 80 (with bar and car wash) inside the village, and the Q8/Shell at Pontives on the SS242 just before Ortisei coming up from Chiusa
places.goodToKnow: Eni open daily 08:00–12:30 & 14:30–19:00 (+39 338 3922443); Q8 daily 08:00–12:00 & 14:00–19:00 (+39 339 3577163); fill up in Bolzano/Chiusa for 24h self-service. Snow chains/winter tyres are mandatory in South Tyrol 15 Nov–15 Apr only, so not required 12–15 Oct unless ice on the passes; no dedicated chain-rental shop exists in the valley – ask the rental company to include chains · Location needs verification
places.address: Streda Tresval 80, 39046 Ortisei BZ (Eni); Pontives, 39046 Ortisei BZ (Q8)

places.name: Tourist Office Ortisei (Val Gardena)
places.near: Streda Rezia 1, next to the Adler hotel at the lower end of the pedestrian zone; 3 min from Garage Central
places.notes: valgardena.it Ufficio turistico Ortisei page (address, coords, seasonal hours)
places.famousFor: Main Val Gardena info office at the start of Streda Rezia: lift timetables, Guest Pass questions, hut opening status, ZTL/parking help, duty-pharmacy and doctor info
places.goodToKnow: Autumn (1 Sep–1 Nov): Mon–Fri 08:30–12:30 & 14:00–18:00, Sat 09:30–12:00, Sun closed; phone +39 0471 777600; sister offices in S. Cristina and Selva

places.name: Dolomiti Wash self-service laundry Ortisei
places.near: Strada Johann Baptist Purger 30, steps from the 'Sarteur' bus stop (line 350), ~10 min walk from the main square
places.notes: Tripadvisor Ortisei forum threads (address, prices) + val-gardena.net FAQ (coin laundry in Ortisei)
places.famousFor: The valley's only coin/self-service laundromat: 4 washers (10 kg / 16 kg) and 3 dryers, detergent included
places.goodToKnow: Open ~08:30–19:00; wash €9 (10 kg) / €12 (16 kg), dryer €4 per 15 min (2025 traveller reports); coins/card per machine; a second self-service laundry is reported behind the Oswald arcade in Selva · Location needs verification
places.address: Strada Johann Baptist Purger 30, 39046 Ortisei BZ
